resources.string: This transaction will be permanently deleted and its amount reverted from the account balance. This can\'t be undone.
"%1$s" will be removed. Its existing transactions won\'t be deleted, but will no longer be linked to any account. This can\'t be undone.
"%1$s" will be removed from your categories and won\'t be offered for new transactions. Transactions already in it keep it.
"%1$s" will no longer be tracked as a recurring bill. This can\'t be undone.
